API for periodic keepalive probes, ACK tracking, and timeout detection.

# Purpose
`fd_keepalive.h` defines a small keepalive state machine for periodic probe transmission and timeout tracking. It declares `fd_keepalive_t`, which stores the next transmit time, the ACK deadline, the configured interval and timeout, the last transmit time, the last receive time, and an `inflight` flag. The inline functions initialize the state, compute a randomized interval reload, decide when to send a probe, update the state after transmit, detect timeout, and process a received ACK while returning the round-trip time.
